episodes.title: Final Exam
episodes.summary: Slade hires the newest graduates of the H.I.V.E. to take on the Teen Titans.

episodes.title: Sisters
episodes.summary: Starfire's sister, Blackfire comes to earth. Weird alien robots start attacking Starfire and it is up to the Teen Titans to protect one of their own, but things are not always what they appear to be.

episodes.title: Divide and Conquer
episodes.summary: Cinderblock breaks Plasmus out of jail and a fight divides some members of the team.

episodes.title: Forces of Nature
episodes.summary: Slade finds a pair of super powered brothers, and convinces them to use their powers for their own amusement, no matter the cost to others. The Titans show up and show them what really matters.

episodes.title: The Sum of His Parts
episodes.summary: Cyborg is frustrated when his limited battery charge allows a villain to escape. The mysterious robot, Fixit, might have the solution - if Cyborg is willing to pay the price.

episodes.title: Nevermore
episodes.summary: After an encounter with Dr. Light, Raven starts acting strangely. Cyborg and Beast Boy go into Raven's room and find themselves encountering several different version of Raven.

episodes.title: Switched
episodes.summary: After an encounter with the Puppet King, Raven and Starfire switch bodies. Now they have to work together to rescue the boys.

episodes.title: Deep Six
episodes.summary: The Titans go after Trident, an undersea criminal, with the assistance of Aqualad.

episodes.title: Masks
episodes.summary: Robin is obsessed with finding Slade. Then a new criminal shows up: Red X. Red X goes on missions stealing equipment for Slade. The Titans try to stop Red X, but he seems to be one step ahead of the Titans.

episodes.title: Mad Mod
episodes.summary: Mad Mod captures the Titans and tries to brain wash them. The Titans are trapped in a weird virtual world, can they find their way to the real world without being brain washed?

episodes.title: Apprentice (1)
episodes.summary: The Titans try to prevent Slade from detonating a bomb while Robin's hatred for Slade comes to a boiling point.

episodes.title: Apprentice (2)
episodes.summary: Faced with a grave threat against his friends, Robin is forced to be Slade's protégé while the team investigates their leader's unknown reasons.

episodes.title: Car Trouble
episodes.summary: Cyborg is in a chase around the city when various villains get their hands on his newly-built "T-Car."

episodes.title: How Long is Forever?
episodes.summary: After Starfire falls through a time portal with a villain named Warp, she has an adventure alone in the future, and now she must find her friends' future selves and get back to her own time.

episodes.title: Every Dog Has His Day
episodes.summary: Feeling unwanted by the other Titans, Beast Boy heads into the city where he encounters a green dog and is then abducted by its owner who refuses to release him. The Titans also encounter this dog, but believe it to be Beast Boy who is unable to change back into his human form.

episodes.title: Terra
episodes.summary: The Titans meet a young girl named Terra who has the power to levitate Earth. Beast Boy falls madly in love with her and they offer her the chance to become a Teen Titan, but she is hiding a secret and only Slade knows the truth.

episodes.title: Only Human
episodes.summary: Cyborg becomes caught up in past memories of his time as a human and begins to feel frustrated by his robotic limitations.

episodes.title: Fear Itself
episodes.summary: Raven doesn't fear anything, or that's at least what she wants the others to think. But when Beast Boy rents a scary film for the Titans to watch later in the night, strange things start to happen, and one by one, each of the Titans starts to disappear. But the main question the remaining Titans, including Raven, are wondering is; Who is behind all of this?

episodes.title: Date with Destiny
episodes.summary: When Killer Moth threatens the city with his army of moths, Robin has no choice but to agree to his demand; He is forced to take his bratty and spoiled daughter Kitten to her junior prom much to Robin's dismay and Starfire's jealousy.

episodes.title: Transformation
episodes.summary: One morning, Starfire finds out she has gained a large lump on her forehead. She is worried at what the others will think so she keeps her lump a secret, but as each day passes, she keeps getting more transformations. Eventually, once her secret is out, Starfire goes into space to find a new home that will accept her new appearance.

episodes.title: Titan Rising
episodes.summary: Terra returns to join the team.

episodes.title: Winner Take All
episodes.summary: Robin, Cyborg and Beast Boy are transported to an alternate dimension where they along with four other heroes, and Gizmo, are invited to compete in "The Tournament of Heroes" to see who is the best hero. But is the tournament really what it sounds like, or is it hiding a more sinister agenda orchestrated by the tournament's host, the Master of Games

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.summary: After a few weeks as a Teen Titan, Terra has everything she ever wanted: a nice home, good friends and even a little romance with Beast Boy. Everything seems perfect, but is it?

episodes.title: Fractured
episodes.summary: When Robin accidentally wrecks the R-Cycle while pursuing a nasty thug named Johnny Rancid, he winds up with his arm in a cast--and doubt in himself.

episodes.title: Aftershock (1)
episodes.summary: A long-lost friend of the Titans returns with a vengeance. Slade orders Overload, Cinder block and Plasmus to launch a series of sinister strikes all over the city. Can our heroes stop Slade and his triad of monsters?

episodes.title: Aftershock (2)
episodes.summary: In a world without Titans, Slade has taken control of everything: the streets, the city and the heart of his young apprentice.

episodes.title: Deception
episodes.summary: School's back in session at the HIVE Academy, and Gizmo, Jinx and Mammoth are up to something. The Titans send Cyborg on an undercover mission.

episodes.title: X
episodes.summary: When the Titans track down the culprit in a string of recent robberies, the teen heroes are shocked to find themselves facing a foe they thought they'd never see again.

episodes.title: Betrothed
episodes.summary: The Teen Titans take a road trip to Starfire's home planet, Tamaran. But this is no ordinary visit: The Grand Ruler of Tamaran has arranged for Starfire to get married!

episodes.title: Crash
episodes.summary: When Beast Boy mistakes Cyborg's system recharger for a video game system, he accidentally infects it with a nasty computer virus; the virus quickly spreads to Cyborg himself causing the half-teen, half-machine to go haywire.

episodes.title: Haunted
episodes.summary: Slade is believed to be gone for good, but Robin is not so sure. His suspicions are confirmed when he finds Slade threatening to destroy the city. Robin is ready to take him down, except for one problem: he can locate Slade, but none of the other Titans can. Now the Titans are starting to wonder if Slade is truly back or if Robin is haunted by the idea of Slade's return?

episodes.title: Spellbound
episodes.summary: There's no one else quite like Raven. Even with four friends around her, Raven still manages to feel alone in Titans' Tower--until she discovers a charming young wizard named Malchior trapped inside one of her ancient books.

episodes.title: Revolution
episodes.summary: The Titans' Fourth of July festivities are cut short when Mad Mod crashes the party and steals Robin's youth.

episodes.title: Wavelength
episodes.summary: Aqualad asks the Titans for help when Brother Blood uses Cyborg's technology to create a doomsday device.

episodes.title: The Beast Within
episodes.summary: After encountering some chemicals in the heat of battle, Beast Boy ends up transforming into a Man Beast.

episodes.title: Can I Keep Him?
episodes.summary: Starfire adopts a weird mutant silkworm named Silkie as a pet. But when she feeds him some alien food from Tamaran, Silkie has an unexpected--and monstrous--growth spurt

episodes.title: Bunny Raven or How to Make a Titananimal Disappear
episodes.summary: Raven and her fellow Titans find themselves trapped in the Amazing Mumbo's hat, when their attempt to interrupt his performance results in him transporting them to another dimension.

episodes.title: Titans East (1)
episodes.summary: The Titans East team complete the tower, and they celebrate with a party. Blood Brother ambushes the unsuspecting heroes.

episodes.title: Titans East (2)
episodes.summary: The final battle continues between Cyborg and Brother Blood as well as the creation of a new branch of Titans.

episodes.title: Don't Touch That Dial
episodes.summary: When Control Freak busts out of jail, throwing him back in should be as easy as clicking a remote; after Control Freak hotwires some high-end AV equipment and escapes into a TV set, things get a little weird.

episodes.title: Cyborg the Barbarian
episodes.summary: Cyborg is mysteriously thrown into the distant past and lands in the middle of a barbarian village that needs his help; but with the nearest charging station 5,000 years in the future, Cyborg has no way to recharge and his power supply is dwindling.

episodes.title: Mother Mae-Eye
episodes.summary: The strange Mother Mae-Eye takes on the Titans as her adopted children and turns the tower into a massive gingerbread house.

episodes.title: Snowblind
episodes.summary: While in Russia, the Titans face off against a radiation monster that is terrorizing a local town. The monster is extremely dangerous as the Titans aren't even able to touch it. Starfire goes off alone to track it down, but becomes lost a snowstorm, luckily she is saved by a man who goes by the name of Red Star. However, Red Star has dangerous powers that aren't controllable and that has forced to isolate himself so that he may not harm anyone. Could Red Star possibly be the monster the Titans are searching for?

episodes.title: Things Change
episodes.summary: After months of fighting the Brotherhood of Evil around the globe, the Teen Titans are finally back home. But a walk through the city reveals that things are no longer as they remembered. And while Beast Boy wants everything to be just like it was in the past, he has to face the fact that in life things change.
